package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"log"
	"os"
	"strconv"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"github.com/vivym/vela/internal/cancellation"
	"github.com/vivym/vela/internal/identity"
	"github.com/vivym/vela/internal/workercontrol"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	authPool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, os.Getenv("VELA_AUTH_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer authPool.Close()
	cancelPool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, os.Getenv("VELA_CANCEL_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer cancelPool.Close()
	internalPool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, os.Getenv("VELA_INTERNAL_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer internalPool.Close()
	pepper, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(os.Getenv("VELA_CREDENTIAL_PEPPER_BASE64"))
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	principal, err := identity.NewAuthenticator(authPool, pepper).Authenticate(
		ctx,
		os.Getenv("VELA_BEARER_CREDENTIAL"),
	)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	projectID, err := uuid.Parse(os.Getenv("VELA_PROJECT_ID"))
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	jobID, err := uuid.Parse(os.Getenv("VELA_JOB_ID"))
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	coordinator := cancellation.NewService(cancelPool, internalPool)
	result, err := coordinator.Cancel(
		ctx,
		principal,
		projectID,
		jobID,
	)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	response := struct {
		Decision       string `json:"decision"`
		ChargeID       string `json:"charge_id"`
		CancellationID string `json:"cancellation_id"`
		StopDecision   string `json:"stop_decision"`
		State          string `json:"state"`
	}{
		Decision:       string(result.Decision),
		CancellationID: result.CancellationID.String(),
		State:          result.State,
	}
	if result.Charge != nil {
		response.ChargeID = result.Charge.ID.String()
	}
	if workerIDText := os.Getenv("VELA_WORKER_ID"); workerIDText != "" {
		workerID, parseErr := uuid.Parse(workerIDText)
		if parseErr != nil {
			log.Fatal(parseErr)
		}
		attemptID, parseErr := uuid.Parse(os.Getenv("VELA_ATTEMPT_ID"))
		if parseErr != nil {
			log.Fatal(parseErr)
		}
		workerEpoch, parseErr := strconv.ParseInt(os.Getenv("VELA_WORKER_EPOCH"), 10, 64)
		if parseErr != nil {
			log.Fatal(parseErr)
		}
		fence, parseErr := strconv.ParseInt(os.Getenv("VELA_ATTEMPT_FENCE"), 10, 64)
		if parseErr != nil {
			log.Fatal(parseErr)
		}
		stopped, stopErr := coordinator.AcknowledgeCancellationStop(
			ctx,
			workercontrol.AuthenticatedWorker{ID: workerID},
			workercontrol.LeaseCredentials{
				AttemptID: attemptID, WorkerEpoch: workerEpoch,
				Fence: fence, Token: os.Getenv("VELA_LEASE_TOKEN"),
			},
			result.CancellationID,
		)
		if stopErr != nil {
			log.Fatal(stopErr)
		}
		response.StopDecision = string(stopped.Decision)
		response.State = stopped.State
	}
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(response); err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
}
